description: Paid live probe of one protocol. Args domain, protocol (ucp, mcp, a2a, x402, and the other detector ids). Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.005 USDC on Base. Full-host refresh_host stays $0.02.

domain.description: Public hostname without a scheme. A scheme, port, path, and leading www. are stripped if present. After normalize: two or more DNS labels, each [a-z0-9] with optional interior hyphens (max 63 chars), total length at most 253. Empty input, literal IPs, and bare labels are rejected.

protocol.description: Detector id, trimmed and lowercased. Must be one of ucp, acp, ap2, tap, mcp, a2a, x402, mpp, llms, ai-plugin, openapi.

name: refresh_host_protocol
